title: On digraphs determined by their singular values
summary: Let $D$ be an digraph of order $n$ with adjacency matrix $A(D)$ and outdegree matrix $Δ^+=Δ^+(D)$. Then the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices of $D$ are respectively defined as $L(D)=Δ^+-A(D)$ and $Q(D)=Δ^++A(D)$. In this paper, we compute singular values and an exact formula for the trace norm of Laplacian matrices of the directed path $\overrightarrow{P_n}$, the directed cycle $\overrightarrow{C_n}$ and all orientations of a star.
